online_offline.value: both; online/digital sales get a fund booster

premium_max.value: Rs 5,00,000 (single, or per year for limited pay)

sum_assured_rule.value: single: 1.25x SP (up to 49) or 1.10x (50+); limited: 7x AP (up to 49) or 5x (50+); maximum for limited pay: higher of 10 or 0.5 x term times AP, term taken as 70 minus age
sum_assured_rule.quote: For Limited Pay – Higher of (10, 0.5 times Policy Term) times Annualized Premium3

life_cover_multiple_choice.quote: Change in Basic Sum Assured is not allowed.
life_cover_multiple_choice.note: SA cannot be changed after issue

premium_allocation_charge.quote: Top-Up Premium Allocation Charge: 1.5% of Single Top-Up Premium

policy_administration_charge.quote: For Single Pay – 0.9% per annum of Single Premium throughout the Policy term

fund_management_charge.quote: Fund Management Charge of 0.5% p.a. will be charged on Discontinued Policy Fund.

mortality_charge.value: rates per 1,000 SAR printed in the policy, set as a % of IALM 2012-14 by age band (160.55% to age 30, 89.05% for 31-40, 74.10% above 40); smokers and women at par; guaranteed
mortality_charge.quote: Smokers and Female lives will be treated at par with other standard lives and will not be charged any extra amount.

discontinuance_charge.quote: There are no discontinuance charges applicable on the TopUp Fund Value.

switching_charge.value: 12 free a year, then Rs 100 per switch (cap Rs 250)
switching_charge.quote: The Fund Switching charge is Rupees One Hundred only (Rs. 100/-) per switch

premium_redirection_charge.quote: There is no Premium Re-direction charge.

value.limited pay: highest of SA less PW in last 2 years, fund value, 105% of premiums
value.single pay: higher of SA less PW, or fund value
value.top-up: higher of top-up SA or top-up fund, in addition

death_benefit_formula.quote: For purpose of determining the Death Benefit under the Policy, the “Deductible Partial Withdrawal” mentioned above shall mean

maturity_benefit.value: fund value plus top-up fund value at age 100
maturity_benefit.quote: If the Insured is alive on the Maturity Date and the Policy is in force, Fund Value (as applicable) and Top Up Fund Value

value.single pay: 0.35% of units each anniversary from the 6th
value.limited pay: 0.20% of units each year from the 11th anniversary

loyalty_additions.quote: In case of single premium Policy 0.35% of the units in each of the funds shall be credited

wealth_boosters_or_guaranteed_additions.value: online/digital only: Fund Booster at maturity of 1% (term up to 14) rising by 1 point per 5 years of term to 10% (55+) of the 8-quarter average fund value
wealth_boosters_or_guaranteed_additions.quote: Fund Booster for Fortune Maxima (only for online channel)

fund_switching.quote: The first twelve (12) switches in any one Policy Year will be processed without a switching fee

premium_redirection.quote: There is no Premium Re-direction charge.

partial_withdrawals.value: after 5 policy anniversaries and age 18; minimum Rs 1,000
partial_withdrawals.quote: You have an option to partially withdraw from the Fund Value at any time provided the Policy has completed at least five (5) Policy Anniversaries

top_up_premiums.value: not in the last 5 years; minimum Rs 5,000, at most 4 a year; SA 1.25x (under 50) or 1.10x
top_up_premiums.quote: Each Top-Up Premium shall not be less than Rupees Five Thousand (Rs. 5,000)

increase_decrease_cover.quote: Change in Basic Sum Assured is not allowed.

change_ppt_or_term.quote: You will not be allowed to change the Premium Paying Term of the Policy.

policy_loan.quote: No loan is available from the Company under this Policy.
